hypothesis: Ten complete, never-consumed fixed-parent trials provide at least 36 successful source episodes in each predeclared ranker-train and final role, so the next causal ranking experiment is not bottlenecked by C40's 22 train mixed groups.
single_variable: Only LIBERO init-state trial changes from C41 trials12..15 to the added trials16..21; parent, checkpoint, action horizon, replan interval, suite/task grid and simulator remain frozen.
parent_baseline: C40 failed fresh ranking at54.32% pairwise and p0.303 with22 train mixed groups. C41 starts the disjoint expansion but reserves only trial15 for final testing, which is not expected to support a powered fresh comparison alone.

architecture.paper: Collect diverse outcomes from a fixed policy before value fitting.
architecture.upstream_code: FACT retains rollout outcomes under one policy snapshot.

data.paper: Value training and final evaluation use distinct episodes.
data.upstream_code: Failure-aware value data retain episode identity.
data.local: Train trials12,13,14,16,17 and final trials15,18,19,20,21 are fixed before C42 outcomes are inspected.
data.rationale: C41's predeclared trial15 final role is preserved.

action.paper: Observed outcomes follow executed policy actions.
action.upstream_code: Fixed actions are executed in simulation.
action.local: H32 first action and replan8 continuation remain unchanged.

objective.upstream_code: Rollouts are collected before value fitting.
objective.local: Require at least36 successful sources and three represented suites in each role.
objective.rationale: This is a data sufficiency gate and makes no model-effect claim.

optimization.local: Zero optimizer steps across240 new episodes.

evaluation.paper: The final set is untouched by fitting or selection.
evaluation.upstream_code: Held-out episode outcomes remain outside training.
evaluation.local: Five train trials and five final trials are immutable for C43.
evaluation.rationale: C43 must preserve these roles at branch level.

evidence: D0-H32-s14000 checkpoint and FACT commit remain fixed.
Trials and roles fixed before inspecting C42 outcomes.
Five-trial final role cannot train or select C43.

decision.rationale: C40's positive ensemble-over-action-only margin warrants more independent source coverage, while its non-significant final result forbids more tuning on C33.
decision.launch_command: After C41 PASS, run trials16/17/18/19 on the four nodes; then trials20/21 on the first two nodes; audit all trials12..21 once.
